expected_issues.description: The hardcoding of `channel='chrome'` in the browser launch call is invalid for non-Chromium browsers (Firefox/WebKit), as the `channel` parameter is exclusively supported by Chromium-based browsers and will cause runtime errors if used with other browser types.
expected_issues.source_text: The hardcoding of `channel='chrome'` in the browser launch call is invalid for non-Chromium browsers (Firefox/WebKit), as the `channel` parameter is exclusively supported by Chromium-based browsers and will cause runtime errors if used with other browser types.

Consider removing forced sync unless strong justification exists.
